policy: The per-DTO comparison in conformance/shapes.go reports every documented divergence it finds, and this file records the ones the broker/ module has, so the Broker API HK surface is measured by the same code as the root module rather than left out of scope. The gate passes when the observed set is EXACTLY the set below and fails in both directions: a divergence not listed is a new defect, and a listed entry that no longer reproduces is either a fix or a check that changed meaning, which are indistinguishable from here. Every entry carries a reason and a recordedIn; loadBrokerBaseline refuses a file whose entries lack either, because an entry with an empty reason is a suppressed finding wearing a comment and one with no recordedIn is merely known with nowhere to read about it. Requiring a reason does not make a reason true, and the reasons here are held to that by review rather than by the schema.

entries.name: from_amount
entries.detail: no json tag in broker.InstantExchange, so the documented value decodes to the zero value
entries.reason: Open defect on the published schema, not waived. The page for this call requires from_amount and no json tag in broker.InstantExchange carries it, so a conforming response decodes the value to its zero value and reports no error. The method sends the path the page documents, so the published schema is this call's contract and the missing tag is a defect rather than a naming choice. Broker API HK returns 401 ROUTE_NOT_PERMITTED in the HK sandbox because the app lacks the required scope, so no live response body can be captured here and none of these rows is live-verified. Fixing one needs a production or US-scoped Broker credential, or a written answer from Webull, and in the direction a probe establishes: a page and a type that disagree cannot both be right, and this file records which of the two the SDK is on without deciding which should change.
